en.title: 10 Must-Watch Apple TV Shows Defining 2026 (So Far)
en.summary: From gripping legal thrillers to expansive sci-fi sagas, this is your definitive rundown of the Apple TV+ series that are making 2026 unmissable.
en.body:
## 1. Widow's Bay
This critically acclaimed drama has cemented its place as a top contender, drawing viewers into its intricate plot with stellar performances. Its compelling narrative and high production value make it a standout addition to the platform's impressive lineup.

## 2. Star City
Expanding the universe of "For All Mankind," this intense, paranoid thriller dives deep into the Soviet space program with creators Matt Wolpert, Ben Nedivi, and Ronald D. Moore at the helm. Set against the backdrop of an alternate 1969, it delivers a masterclass in suspense and historical reimagining.

## 3. Imperfect Women
A series lauded for its unique storytelling and powerful cast, "Imperfect Women" offers a fresh perspective that has captivated audiences worldwide. Its narrative depth and character development are key reasons for its inclusion.

## 4. Presumed Innocent
David E. Kelly's legal thriller starring Jake Gyllenhaal as a prosecutor caught in a murder investigation is a tense, character-driven dive into the justice system. The series excels at building suspense as Gyllenhaal's character becomes the prime suspect.

## 5. Foundation
Jared Harris and Lee Pace anchor this ambitious sci-fi drama, which continues to explore the vast lore of the Galactic Empire. Its complex narrative and stunning visuals have made it a cornerstone of Apple TV+'s genre offerings.

## 6. For All Mankind
This long-running alt-history space race drama continues to captivate with its compelling blend of historical revisionism and character drama. The series consistently delivers high-stakes storytelling that resonates with its dedicated fanbase.

## 7. The Outsider
With an 81% score, this series has earned its spot through consistently strong writing and performances that keep viewers on the edge of their seats. It's a testament to Apple TV+'s ability to deliver high-quality genre content.

## 8. Task
Boasting a solid 78% score, "Task" has proven itself to be a compelling watch, likely due to its engaging plotlines and well-executed direction. It's a show that demands attention and rewards viewers with quality television.

## 9. True Detective
While its score is slightly lower at 74%, the enduring appeal and critical discussion surrounding "True Detective" make it a significant entry for the year. Its reputation for gritty storytelling and complex mysteries precedes it.

## 10. SEAL Team
This action-packed series, holding an impressive 85% score, continues to deliver thrilling storylines and intense missions. Its consistent quality and dedicated following solidify its place as a fan favorite on the platform.

Bottom Line: Apple TV+ continues to dominate the streaming landscape with a diverse slate of critically acclaimed and fan-favorite series that push the boundaries of television storytelling.

content_raw: Between great new series and high quality seasons of television, 2026 has been an amazing year for Apple TV. We've ranked the platform's best shows of the year.
